title: 'In flight now' card overstates live work: ~1/3 of in_flight rows are owned by archived/finished sessions
note: MEASURED 2026-11-15T10:30Z, live store (work.py list --state in_flight): 65 in_flight rows (the Overview card showed 47). The ML rows (15 FRONTIER + FRONTIER-Q-RESID-ENTRY + 4 bare ML-PRIMARY) wait on ML-PRIMARY-2's confirmation, asked 10:37Z, with a 12:30Z fallback. (b) structural: PR #26276 (hold, unvouchable_paths) adds openNow quiet/quietHours and openNowCounts to /api/bot/work/snapshot; the basis is row activity (48 h), because the VM cannot see session status. 13 of 43 were quiet at 10:45Z.
